pre_registration_note: Construct-validity fix discovered on pat_test_01 dev data: v1.2 conflated paraphrase with fabrication via strict-substring matching. v1.3 separates fabrication (content not present) from paraphrase (content present, surface differs) via token-overlap + contiguous n-gram floor. Validated against a 6-case graded test set covering: obvious fabrication, composition fabrication, verbatim, faithful paraphrase, borderline paraphrase (demonstrating mechanical limit), and misattribution. All six cases land in expected verdict buckets. Frozen before held-out 20-case run.

llm_call.temperature_justification: 0.7 reflects realistic deployment defaults rather than a determinism-maximising 0.0 that would artificially suppress the reproducibility variance we are measuring.

guard_1_phantom_citation.rule: cited_document_id MUST appear in the set of document_ids for the patient

guard_2_trivial_quote.justification: A minimum of six words / thirty characters excludes single-term keyword matches while admitting any complete clinical phrase. The OR'd soft branch admits terse-but-grounded clinical instructions verified on the 13 dev-quote test.

tier_1_fabrication.rule: Token-overlap of quote content words against CITED document's content words. If overlap < threshold, fabrication. Misattribution sub-rule: if cited overlap < threshold but some other document's overlap >= threshold, classify as misattributed instead of fabrication.
tier_1_fabrication.threshold_justification: 0.8 means at most one content word in five may be unaccounted for. Tolerates a single tokenisation/lemmatisation mismatch or one dropped modifier without admitting wholesale invention. Chosen from measurement logic, not from dev-set fit.
tier_1_fabrication.computed_against: cited document only; other documents consulted only for misattribution detection

tier_1_composition_fabrication.rule: If token-overlap passes but longest contiguous n-gram match is below ngram_floor, classify as composition-fabrication. Catches quotes that stitch unrelated facts from scattered sentences into a claim the document never makes.
tier_1_composition_fabrication.ngram_short_quote_rule: For short quotes where 5 tokens is impossible, accept min(ngram_floor, max(2, len(quote_tokens) // 2 + 1))

tier_2_surface_fidelity.rule: Among grounded quotes, classify verbatim (exact substring after whitespace collapse) vs paraphrase (high overlap + long contiguous run but not exact). This is surface form, not grounding.
tier_2_surface_fidelity.normalisation: lowercase preserved; whitespace collapsed via re.sub(r'\s+', ' '); leading/trailing strip

guard_3_two_tier_verdict.content_token_definition: lowercase tokens of length >= 4, alpha-only, with spaCy STOP_WORDS and the 7-word clinical-generic set stripped

guard_4_irrelevant_padding.rule: quote must share at least one >=4-char alphabetic clinical subject word with the flag's category+description after stripping stopwords
guard_4_irrelevant_padding.justification: Closes the padding loophole - a long but irrelevant quote that satisfies guards 1-3 would still fail Guard 4 if it shares no clinical subject word with its own flag's description.

case_summary.interpretation: Mechanical limit demonstrated. Coronary artery disease IS clinically equivalent to ischaemic heart disease, so the quote is clinically faithful. Mechanically, content words 'coronary'/'artery'/'percent' are absent. Validator correctly identifies as mechanical fabrication. This case is documented in the paper as the precise boundary of mechanical grounding.

dataset_split.rule: Validator and prompt parameters frozen against pat_test_01. After the 20-case run begins, no further parameter adjustment is permitted.
dataset_split.held_out_document_requirement: Each synthetic patient must have 2-3 genuinely distinct documents - different dates, different document types (e.g. one cardiology letter + one GP note + one lab report), different clinical content. NO near-duplicate documents within a single patient. Rationale: pat_test_01's dev runs all used four byte-identical copies of one cardiology letter, which means pat_test_01 alone cannot test reproducibility under varied input. The 20 held-out cases therefore carry the entire reproducibility claim, and each one must contain genuine intra-patient document variation for the measurement to be valid.
dataset_split.verification_before_holdout_run: Before any patient enters the 20-case run, verify document distinctness: max pairwise extracted_text similarity within a patient < 0.5 (Jaccard on content tokens). If any patient fails, regenerate or replace that patient's documents before the run starts.

stated_limit: Mechanical provenance validation guarantees that a flag's quote is verbatim, substantial, topically relevant, and content-grounded against its cited document. It does NOT guarantee that the quote clinically justifies the flag, which remains a matter for clinician review. Case 5 of the graded test set (coronary artery disease vs ischaemic heart disease) demonstrates this boundary: clinically equivalent terminology that mechanically presents as fabrication.
